command.summary: Create a Vault or HSM. RBAC authorization is enabled by default. If `--enable-rbac-authorization` is manually specified to `false` and `--no-self-perms` flag is not specified, default permissions are created for the current user or service principal. If you want to assign the default permission, you have to change the default subscription with `az account set` first, instead of using `--subscription`.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --administrators
parameters.help: [HSM Only] Administrator role for data plane operations for Managed HSM. It accepts a space separated list of OIDs that will be assigned.

parameters.name: --enable-purge-protection
parameters.help: Property specifying whether protection against purge is enabled for this vault/managed HSM pool. Setting this property to true activates protection against purge for this vault/managed HSM pool and its content - only the Key Vault/Managed HSM service may initiate a hard, irrecoverable deletion. The setting is effective only if soft delete is also enabled. Enabling this functionality is irreversible.

parameters.name: --enable-rbac-authorization
parameters.help: Property that controls how data actions are authorized. When true, the key vault will use Role Based Access Control (RBAC) for authorization of data actions, and the access policies specified in vault properties will be ignored. When false, the key vault will use the access policies specified in vault properties, and any policy stored on Azure Resource Manager will be ignored. If null or not specified, the vault is created with the default value of true. Note that management actions are always authorized with RBAC.

parameters.name: --enabled-for-deployment
parameters.help: [Vault Only] Property to specify whether Azure Virtual Machines are permitted to retrieve certificates stored as secrets from the key vault.

parameters.name: --enabled-for-disk-encryption
parameters.help: [Vault Only] Property to specify whether Azure Disk Encryption is permitted to retrieve secrets from the vault and unwrap keys.

parameters.name: --enabled-for-template-deployment
parameters.help: [Vault Only] Property to specify whether Azure Resource Manager is permitted to retrieve secrets from the key vault.

parameters.name: --hsm-name
parameters.help: Name of the HSM. (--hsm-name and --name/-n are mutually exclusive, please specify just one of them).

parameters.name: --location
parameters.help: Location. You can configure the default location using `az configure --defaults location=<location>`.

parameters.name: --mi-user-assigned
parameters.help: [HSM Only] Enable user-assigned managed identities for managed HSM. Accept space-separated list of identity resource IDs.

parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: Name of the Vault.

parameters.name: --no-self-perms
parameters.help: [Vault Only] Don't add permissions for the current user/service principal in the new vault.

parameters.name: --no-wait
parameters.help: Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish.

parameters.name: --public-network-access
parameters.help: Control permission for data plane traffic coming from public networks while private endpoint is enabled.

parameters.name: --retention-days
parameters.help: Soft delete data retention days. It accepts >=7 and <=90. Defaults to 90 for keyvault creation. Required for MHSM creation.

parameters.name: --sku
parameters.help: Required. SKU details. Allowed values for Vault: premium, standard. Allowed values for HSM: Standard_B1, Custom_B32, Custom_B6, Custom_C42, Custom_C10.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use '' to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --bypass
parameters.help: Bypass traffic for space-separated uses.

parameters.name: --default-action
parameters.help: Default action to apply when no rule matches.

parameters.name: --network-acls
parameters.help: Network ACLs. It accepts a JSON filename or a JSON string. JSON format: `{\"ip\":[<ip1>, <ip2>...],\"vnet\":[<vnet_name _1>/<subnet_name_1>,<subnet_id2>...]}`.

parameters.name: --network-acls-ips
parameters.help: Network ACLs IP rules. Space-separated list of IP addresses.

parameters.name: --network-acls-vnets
parameters.help: Network ACLS VNet rules. Space-separated list of Vnet/subnet pairs or subnet resource ids.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
